sentences.quote: Mr. Lee Yuan Siong today assumed the role of Group Chief Executive and President of AIA Group Limited ("AIA" or the "Company") and joined the Company's Board of Directors. He succeeds Mr. Ng Keng Hooi
sentences.text: Lee Yuan Siong has been Group Chief Executive and President of AIA Group Limited and an executive director since 1 June 2020, when he joined the board and succeeded Ng Keng Hooi.

Born in Singapore in 1965, he has more than 30 years of experience in the insurance sector, beginning his career at the Monetary Authority of Singapore and holding senior leadership positions at Prudential plc before Ping An, where he was chairman and CEO of Ping An Life and later co-CEO, executive director and group chief insurance business officer.

sentences.quote: Lee Yuan Siong is a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (US) and a Chartered Financial Analyst (US). He serves as board of trustees of the Wealth Management Institute. He holds a Master of Finance degree
sentences.text: He is a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (US) and a Chartered Financial Analyst, with a Master of Finance from the University of Cambridge and a BSc in actuarial science from the London School of Economics.
He fronted AIA's 2026 interim results, which showed value of new business up 10% to $3.2 billion.

mgmt_bio.text: Lee Yuan Siong has been Group Chief Executive and President of AIA Group Limited and an executive director since 1 June 2020, when he joined the board and succeeded Ng Keng Hooi. He is a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (US) and a Chartered Financial Analyst, with a Master of Finance from the University of Cambridge and a BSc in actuarial science from the London School of Economics.

citations.title: AIA delivers strong first half results in 2026

sentences.quote: Value of new business (VONB) of US$3,212 million, up 10 per cent overall and 14 per cent excluding Thailand
sentences.text: AIA Group reported first-half 2026 value of new business of US$3,212 million, up 10 per cent, or 14 per cent excluding Thailand, with growth across all distribution channels and all reportable segments except Thailand.

sentences.quote:
Operating profit after tax (OPAT) of US$4,163 million, up 13 per cent per share
AIA now expects to exceed OPAT per share CAGR target of 9 to 11 per cent from 2023 to 2026
sentences.text: Operating profit after tax reached US$4,163 million, up 13 per cent per share, and AIA now expects to exceed its 9 to 11 per cent operating profit per share growth target for 2023 to 2026, with record annualised operating ROEV of 18.0 per cent and operating ROE of 17.5 per cent.
New business margin remained strong at 57.1 per cent, which management frames as growing at scale while keeping attractive new business economics.

Capital returns are substantial: the interim dividend rose 10 per cent to HK$53.90 per share, and cumulative buybacks since 2022 total US$15.4 billion within US$26.6 billion of total shareholder returns.
Geographical expansion in Mainland China has more than doubled target customers to over 340 million across 14 geographies.

thesis_pillars.text: AIA Group reported first-half 2026 value of new business of US$3,212 million, up 10 per cent, or 14 per cent excluding Thailand, with growth across all distribution channels and all reportable segments except Thailand. Operating profit after tax reached US$4,163 million, up 13 per cent per share, and AIA now expects to exceed its 9 to 11 per cent operating profit per share growth target for 2023 to 2026, with record annualised operating ROEV of 18.0 per cent and operating ROE of 17.5 per cent.
